caption:
Dependent sons make dependent boyfriends. Your dating fails because of where you live. Self respect is your responsibility.

When you're still in your parents' house, she feels it. You expect her to do what your mom did: take care of you. That's not attractive. That's pathetic. Move out. Run your own place. Build discipline and self respect. That's when real dating begins.
